0038: def performance_v2_1_4_category_scope():
0039:     ensure_category_scope_schema()
0040:     seed_default_categories(overwrite=False)
0041:     if request.method == "POST":
0042:         action = request.form.get("action") or "create_scope_draft"
0043:         try:
0044:             if action == "create_scope_draft":
0045:                 result = upsert_category_scope_draft(
0046:                     request.form.get("category_key") or "diger",
0047:                     request.form.get("scope_name") or None,
0048:                     request.form.get("notes") or "Kategori kapsam hazırlığı.",
0049:                     getattr(current_user, "id", None),
0050:                     request.form.get("visibility_mode") or "summary_only",
0051:                 )
0052:                 flash(f"Kategori kapsam taslağı kaydedildi: {result.get('scope_name')}", "success")
0053:             elif action == "deactivate_scope_draft":
0054:                 scope_key = request.form.get("scope_key") or ""
0055:                 if scope_key:
0056:                     deactivate_scope_draft(scope_key)
0057:                     flash("Kapsam taslağı pasife alındı.", "success")
0058:             elif action == "create_category":
0059:                 result = create_or_update_category(request.form.get("display_name") or "", request.form.get("description") or "")
0060:                 flash(result.get("message") or f"Kategori kaydedildi: {result.get('display_name')}", "success" if result.get("ok") else "warning")
0061:             elif action == "delete_category":
0062:                 result = delete_category_safely(request.form.get("category_key") or "")
0063:                 flash(result.get("message") or "Kategori işlemi tamamlandı.", "success" if result.get("ok") else "warning")
0064:             elif action == "restore_category":
0065:                 result = restore_category(request.form.get("category_key") or "")
0066:                 flash(result.get("message") or "Kategori yeniden aktifleştirildi.", "success")
0067:             elif action == "seed":
0068:                 result = seed_default_categories(overwrite=False)
0069:                 flash(f"Kategori listesi kontrol edildi. Yeni: {result.get('created', 0)}, mevcut: {result.get('unchanged', 0)}", "success")
0070:         except Exception as exc:
0071:             logger.exception("BYS360 performans modülünde beklenmeyen hata yakalandı.")
0072:             flash(f"Kategori kapsam işlemi tamamlanamadı: {exc}", "danger")
0073:         return redirect(url_for("main.performance_v2_1_4_category_scope"))
